title: Question 8
passage:
Why is this quote higher even though we ordered fewer signs?
A. The rush fee is larger than the saving on materials. B. The delivery address is printed at the bottom. C. Please ask the buyer to initial the revised order.
passageZh:
明明訂的招牌比較少，為什麼這份報價反而比較高？
A. 急件費比省下的材料費還多。 B. 送貨地址印在下方。 C. 請買方在修訂後的訂單上簽姓名縮寫。
